title: ThinkOne UI inventory — approval-stage snapshot
methodology: Lexical extraction of declarations and template inline style attributes; counts describe distinct written values, not computed design variants.
Primary statistics apply to demo/styles.css. Inline styles from app.js and index.html are listed separately.
Zero font size, keyframes, geometric values, dynamic template expressions, and print-document values may be legitimate, not inconsistencies.
Rule matching is not a full CSS parser or dead-code proof; dynamically assembled classes must be checked before removal.
View blocks may include shared helpers before the next View declaration; per-block counts are not exclusive per-page runtime totals.
Browser findings are sampled real content, not an exhaustive traversal of all roles, workflows, or states.

browserFindings.viewport1440: No whole-page horizontal overflow in sampled 22 addresses.
browserFindings.table: Offer table minimum width about 780 px inside a roughly 283 px mobile container.
browserFindings.coverage: Source: 23 View definitions plus object creation/edit routes (26 router entries total). Runtime: 22 representative addresses at desktop/320 px, six at 768 px, plus client portal. Some native lease/employment detail states were source/gallery-only due to available data.
